name: pdfcraft-bridge
description: Read, split, merge, organize, watermark, protect, redact, fill, sign, convert, compress and OCR PDFs with the PdfCraft editor installed on Windows, macOS or Linux. Not affiliated with PdfCraft or Storytold.

pdfcraft_dir.title: PdfCraft folder
pdfcraft_dir.description: Install folder of PdfCraft (or PdfCraft.app on macOS). Leave empty to auto-detect: C:\Program Files\PdfCraft, /Applications/PdfCraft.app, /usr/bin, /opt/pdfcraft or PATH.

pdfcraft_cli.title: pdfcraft-cli executable (optional)
pdfcraft_cli.description: Only if it is somewhere else, e.g. where you unzipped pdfcraft-cli-<version>-macos-universal.zip on macOS.

pdfcraft_root.title: Limit access to this folder (optional)
pdfcraft_root.description: When set, PdfCraft may only read and write files inside this folder.
